server.not_connected_body: Open the SSH session to list and manage this server's domains.
server.none_connected: No server connected. Connect one or more servers to use the aggregated view.

reason.not_configured: command not configured for this server
reason.sudo_denied: sudo not allowed for this SSH account

details.title: Domain details
details.readonly_hint: These settings come from the shared nginx vhost and are not changed per domain.

create.title: New domain
create.label: Domain name
create.hint: Without “www.” or “https://”. The <root>/<domain>/public_html folder will be provisioned by the server script.

delete.title: Delete domain
delete.warning: This cannot be undone: files, PHP pool and registry entry of {domain} will be removed.

errors.network: The back-office cannot be reached. Check that the application is running.
errors.auth_required: Session expired: please sign in again.
errors.auth_too_many: Too many attempts. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.domain_www: Enter the domain without the “www.” prefix (www redirects are handled by nginx).
errors.domain_locked: {domain} is locked: unlock it before deleting.
errors.confirm_mismatch: The confirmation does not match the domain name.
errors.ssh_auth_failed: SSH authentication rejected by {server} (key or password).
errors.ssh_host_key_mismatch: {server}'s host key has changed! Connection blocked (possible man-in-the-middle attack).
errors.ssh_host_key_unknown: Unknown host key for {server} (strict mode enabled).
errors.ssh_timeout: The command exceeded the time limit on {server}.
errors.ssh_sudo_denied: sudo denied on {server}: a NOPASSWD sudoers rule is required for this command.
errors.ssh_lock_failed: The lockop service on {server} rejected the operation.
errors.file_name_invalid: Invalid name: {name}. Slashes and control characters are not allowed.
errors.file_outside: Path outside the domain root: operation refused.
errors.file_docroot_missing: The web root of this domain was not found on {server}.
errors.file_too_big: Content too large for this operation.
errors.file_too_big_edit: File too large for the editor ({size} maximum). Download it instead.
errors.file_conflict: {name} changed on the server since you opened it. Reload before saving.
errors.file_locked: {domain} is locked: files are read-only. Unlock the domain first.
errors.file_zip_invalid: {name} is not a valid ZIP archive.
errors.lock_unknown_site: {domain} is not managed by the lockop service on {server}. That service validates sites against its own host-side list: the domain must be declared there (the folder does exist in the container).
errors.forbidden: Action refused: your role lacks the “{permission}” right.
errors.server_forbidden: Your account has no access to server {server}.
errors.auth_disabled: This account is disabled. Contact an administrator.
errors.auth_locked: Too many failed sign-ins: account locked for {minutes} minute(s).
errors.password_too_short: The password must be at least {min} characters long.
errors.user_name_invalid: Invalid username: {username} (3 to 32 characters: letters, digits, dot, dash, underscore).
errors.user_last_admin: Not possible: at least one active administrator must remain.
errors.user_self_disable: You cannot disable your own account.
errors.user_self_role: You cannot change your own role.
errors.user_self_delete: You cannot delete your own account.
errors.role_system_readonly: Role {name} is built-in and cannot be modified.
errors.role_in_use: Role {name} is assigned to {count} account(s): reassign them first.
errors.design_too_large: Content too large for the editor.
errors.design_section_missing: Block {section} is not installed on this site.
errors.design_content_marker: Content cannot contain a lone “HTML;” line.
errors.design_content_unsafe: Content cannot contain scripts or PHP code.
errors.design_not_supported: {domain} does not use the fleet site engine.
errors.design_write_denied: Write refused on {server}: check that the domain is unlocked.
errors.design_preview_failed: The preview could not be created on {server}.
errors.design_lint_failed: PHP rejected the generated file: publishing cancelled.
errors.design_conflict: Site {domain} changed since your draft started.
errors.design_verify_failed: Post-write verification failed on {domain}: the backup was restored.
errors.design_article_unsupported: This article does not have the expected structure: {file}.
errors.design_preview_expired: This preview has expired. Start it again from the editor.
errors.design_image_invalid: This file is not a recognised image (JPEG, PNG, WebP or GIF).
errors.design_image_failed: The image could not be prepared on {server}.
errors.translate_batch_too_big: Too many domains in one batch ({max} maximum).
errors.translate_unavailable: Automatic translation is not configured on this back office.
errors.translate_failed: The translation service refused the request.
errors.phrase_source_invalid: The source word must be 2 to 160 characters long.
errors.phrase_target_invalid: The translation must be 1 to 160 characters long.
errors.phrase_same: The translation is identical to the source word.

files.title: Files
files.truncated: Showing only the first {limit} entries of this folder.
files.locked: Domain locked: read-only. Unlock it to modify files.
files.compress_hint: The archive will be created in the current folder from {count} item(s).
files.extract_hint: The contents of {name} will be extracted into a new folder.
files.delete_warning: {count} item(s) will be deleted. Folders go with all their contents.
files.binary: Binary file: cannot be edited. Use download instead.
files.fix_perms_hint: Remember to repair permissions after changes.
files.upload_hint: Up to {size} per upload. Rejected if an entry with that name already exists.

admin.title: Administration
admin.subtitle: Accounts, roles and permissions
admin.form_must_change: Require a change at first sign-in
admin.delete_user_warning: Account {username} and its open sessions will be removed.
admin.reset_hint: Open sessions of this account will be closed.
admin.password_copy: Write this password down: it will not be shown again.

account.title: My account
account.changed: Password changed. Your other sessions were closed.
account.must_change: You must change your password before continuing.

design.title: Design & content
design.subtitle: Customise the look and wording of the site
design.draft_saved: Draft saved. Nothing is live yet.
design.stale: Careful: the site changed elsewhere since this draft started.
design.preview_note: Private link, not indexed, valid for {minutes} minutes. The live site is untouched.
design.publish_warning: Changes will be visible immediately on {domain}. A backup is created automatically before writing.
design.discard_warning: All unpublished changes will be lost.
design.empty_sections: No block: the home page would be empty.
design.article_search: Search a title or an address…
design.rt_hint: Select text, then choose a format.
design.restore_warning: File {name} will replace the live version.
design.unsupported: This domain does not use the fleet site engine: the editor does not apply.
design.locked: Domain locked: unlock it to publish.
design.publish_cache: Files are updated. The public page may take a few minutes to refresh (server and CDN cache); the link below bypasses that cache.
design.choose_layout_hint: Your texts and images are kept: only the presentation of the “{family}” block changes.
design.delete_block_warning: The “{name}” block will be removed from the home page. The other blocks stay as they are, and nothing goes live before publishing.
design.back_to_blocks: Back to the list of blocks
design.add_block_hint: The block is added at the end of the page. You can move it with the arrows.
design.block_added: “{name}” block added at the end of the page
design.empty_hint: Add a first block to build the page.
design.flow_hint: Saved automatically as a draft · nothing is live until you publish

layout.bottom: Background image, text at the bottom

purpose.hero: The first thing visitors see: title, visual and button.
purpose.categories: Guides visitors to the sections of the site.
purpose.split: An image and a text side by side.
purpose.cta: Invites the visitor to take action.
purpose.newsletter: Invites visitors to subscribe to the newsletter.

hint.badge: Small wording shown above the title.
hint.image_alt: Describes the image for people who cannot see it and for search engines.
hint.count: The most recent articles are pulled in automatically.
hint.meta_description: About 160 characters, shown in search results.

design.color_select_first: Select the text you want to colour first.
design.mode_text_hint: HTML source. Only the tags the site can display are kept.
design.image_import_hint: JPEG, PNG, WebP or GIF. The 400, 600, 900 and 1920 pixel versions are created automatically, in WebP and JPEG.
design.image_imported: {count} files created from a {width} × {height} pixel image.

actions.title: Actions
actions.pick_server_first: Pick a server in the sidebar first, or paste a list of domains.
actions.list_hint: Paste the domains, one per line or comma separated. They may come from several servers: the back office sorts them out.
actions.offline: Servers not connected — their domains cannot be found: {servers}
actions.parc_hint: Every connected server is scanned, one after another. Allow a few minutes for the whole estate; the Stop button stays available.
actions.parc_loading: Reading the domains of each server…
actions.server_failed: {server}: scan interrupted, the other servers carry on.

translate.explain: The back office reads the home page of the selected sites and spots texts written in a language other than the site’s own. Nothing is modified during the scan.
translate.scan_done: Scan finished: {sites} site(s) to fix, {texts} text(s) found.
translate.all_clean_hint: Every home page scanned is written in its own site language.
translate.pick_site: Pick a site from the list.
translate.safety_note: Publishing backs up config.php, checks the syntax of the generated file, then reads the site back: on any mismatch the backup is restored automatically.
translate.nothing_selected: No text is both ticked and filled in.
translate.nothing_to_fill: Every text already has a suggested translation.
translate.filled: Translations suggested: check them before publishing.
translate.skipped: {count} text(s) left untouched: they changed on the server.

source.tld: Site language: inferred from the .{hint} extension
source.content: Site language: inferred from the page content

translate.uncertain_hint: Short text: the analysis hesitates between two languages. Read it before translating.
translate.filled_all: {count} translation(s) suggested. Check them before publishing.
translate.publish_all_body: {sites} site(s) and {texts} text(s) will go live.
translate.no_provider: Automatic translation is not configured: add a key to .env (DEEPL_KEY, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, GOOGLE_TRANSLATE_KEY or LIBRETRANSLATE_URL), then restart the server.
translate.tags_differ: Tags differ from the original ({tags}): check they wrap the same words.
translate.tags_moved: The tags no longer wrap the same words ({tags}): the emphasis has shifted.
translate.stat_skipped_hint: No config.php: these sites run on a different engine. This is not a fault.

templates.explain: The back office looks through the engine files — parts/, 404.php, sitemap.php… — for visible words still in French, and offers the exact translation from the site lexicon. Article content and links are never touched.
templates.pick_site: Pick a site from the list.
templates.apply_all_body: {sites} site(s) and {texts} text(s) will be fixed in production.
templates.from_lexicon: Translations from the site lexicon (parts/lang.php) and the estate dictionary.
templates.safety_note: Every file is checked with php -l, backed up under .lkm-backups/templates/, then written in place. Articles, links and multilingual tables are never touched.
templates.failed: {count} file(s) refused — nothing written for those.
templates.all_clean_hint: Every template scanned is in its own site language.
templates.stat_source_hint: French is the estate source language: there is nothing to translate on a French site.
templates.dict_hint: Used across the whole estate, for every later scan.
templates.todo_hint: Add the word and the next scan will fix it everywhere.
